_doc: Corrections to the server data, applied to data/items.json and data/combos.json by tools/apply_data_fixes.py (build_equip_data.py runs it too). Each fix was checked against the GGT client description and confirmed by the user.

items.why: Time Jewelry Amulet: GGT description says +melee / ranged physical damage, the server had ranged damage taken (bLongAtkDef)

combos.why: Young Leaf of World Tree: total refine is armor + garment (the leaf is a lower headgear and cannot be refined); the server also counted the middle headgear
Temporal Jewel (Agi) Lv.3 + Time Jewelry Amulet (Lv.2) gave the Lv.3 bonus; the Lv.2 amulet only gives the Lv.2 bonus
Temporal Jewel (Agi) Lv.3 + Time Jewelry Amulet (Lv.3): the server had the Lv.2 amulet in this set
Lv.2 amulet + Temporal Jewel Lv.3 (in the circlet) (Str): Lv.2 bonus; the amulet itself takes Time Jewel Lv.2 only
